x: Our sole representative in the Boys 3,000m was Kevin McDermot, a newcomer who clocked a creditable 17:11 for 17th. Kevin and his brother Trevor look tough and strong and are training with Ray Middleton who lives nearby - those Hendon roads will soon need re-surfacing.

Kevin and Trevor McDermot both competed in 1 mile events, being timed at 8:51 and 8:03 respectively. In the open 10Km event held at the Lugano Cup Final meeting, Milton Keynes on September 25th, Graham Seatter was below his best form and placed 16th in 47:34.

We had competitors out in each of the age groups, closing in teams in the Boys and Juniors races. Over 3,000 metres our boys team placed 12th with 96 points - K.McDermot 19th in 16:50, G.Sexton 36th in 17:54 and S.

Meanwhile the Boys (13-15) 5,000, had got under way and Kevin McDermot was already making his presence felt, but as the race progressed some of his speedier rivals pulled away, but he showed his fighting qualities to bring out a personal best.
Teams: Steyning 37pts; Belgrave H 42pts; Ilford 56pts. Youth 5Kms. 5.M.Nicholls 25:46; 9.K.McDermot 27:08; 11.P.Morris 27:28

Kevin McDermot (Mddx.) put up a PB to finish 20th in 26:05, whilst S.Sethi did a creditable 27:03 to finish 29th. Peter Morris was on the sidelines as a reserve for Surrey, unfortunately he had an "off-day" on the day of the trial; had he walked he would have gained a good placing.

Fortunately the few who raced all did themselves credit - particularly John Newnham and Peter Morris. 1.D.Rowland (Steyning) 78:32; 3.J.Newnham 79:12; 11.V.Hutchins 83:01; 22.P.Morris 86:44; 26.K.McDermot 89:43; 27.T.McDermot 89:50.
We had County Champions in Graham Seatter, John Hall, Carl Lawton, Richard Dorman, Kevin McDermot, Trevor McDermot, Linda and Mike Nicholls.
In the Youth/Junior 3kms event Richard Dorman was our first home, 2nd in 13:51, followed by M.Nicholls 5th 14:40 and K.
Our winning score was a low 6 points from Brighton's 15 and Waltham Forest's 25. Over 5kms Mike Nicholls gained us another 2nd place in 24:20, with K.McDermot 8th in 25:48 and P.
A great performance by one of the youngest in the race was that of Kevin McDermot, 53rd in a time which indicates that he will soon be under the hour for seven miles.

Mike Nicholls led them home in 3rd spot, taking 24 minutes 15 seconds for the 5 kilometre course. Other placings were: R.Dorman 5th 24:38; K.McDermot 7th 24:40: T. McDermot 10th 25:33 and P.Morris 18th 27:51.
Last event to be mentioned in the English Schools is the Intermediate Boys 5kms in which Belgrave had a winner with Mike Nicholls in 23.19; and 7th Kevin McDermot in 24.45.
Junior Mens 5kms: 1.R.Dorman 23.46; 3.K.McDermot 25.35. Boys U.13: 6.I.McDermot 10.56; Womens 3kms: 14.W.Dunsford 20.53; Girls U 15: 7.T.McDermot 12.06.

Youth 3kms: 1.G.Maynard (Camb.) 13.39; 2.M.Nicholls 14.05; 3.K.McDermot 14.06; As a result of this meeting Richard Dorman was selected for his second Junior International, this time against Poland and Italy at Wolverhampton.
Bels were relying on two Youths to keep the flag flying and so they did despite Kevin McDermot losing a few places in the last three laps, but Mike Nicholls held on for third.

If there were prizes for determination then winners would have been Kevin McDermot and Martin Hills. There are others who deserve special note, but I think the relevant race reports that follow will highlight their achievements.
